R_DOMAIN_FIN.title: ERP Finance & Accounting Invariants
R_DOMAIN_FIN.summary: ERP Finance: Strict accounting period lock (strictly no retroactive edits to closed financial periods), double-entry balance verification (Total Debit == Total Credit on all posted vouchers), currency rounding discipline, and immutable posted general ledger transactions.

R_DOMAIN_WMS.title: ERP Warehouse Management & Stock Handover
R_DOMAIN_WMS.summary: ERP WMS & Handover: Strict 2-step transfer gate (Dispatched -> In-Transit -> Received), bin/location capacity validation before storage assignment, and mandatory physical handover acknowledgment before stock ledger debit/credit.

R_DOMAIN_INV.title: ERP Inventory & Warehouse Invariants
R_DOMAIN_INV.summary: Inventory & Warehouse Invariants: Strict physical vs ledger reconciliation, transactional row-level stock locks (UPDLOCK, ROWLOCK), FIFO/LIFO ledger immutability, zero negative inventory unless explicit backorder configuration, atomic lot reservations.

R_DOMAIN_PROD.title: ERP Production & Lot Traceability
R_DOMAIN_PROD.summary: Production & Lot Traceability: End-to-end Lot/Serial traceability across BOM stages, immutable process sign-offs, ticket-to-journal stage transitions, zero unverified scrap or material substitution, continuous defect logging.

R_DOMAIN_SALES.title: ERP Sales Order & Packaging Flow
R_DOMAIN_SALES.summary: Sales & Packaging Flow: Deterministic price and discount calculation decoupled from UI, mandatory approval gate before warehouse stock-out, selective packing log (NKDG) generation, immutable audit journaling.

R_DOMAIN_AUTH.title: ERP Enterprise RBAC & Data Tenancy
R_DOMAIN_AUTH.summary: Enterprise RBAC & Data Sovereignty: 2-tier authorization matrix (Feature-Action CRUD/Export/Approve + Row-Level Security tenancy filters), client UI signal delegation vs backend hard authorization filters, least-privilege service delegation.
